hummus.key_ingredients: Chickpeas, tahini (sesame), olive oil, lemon juice, garlic
hummus.rationale: 100% plant-based legumes and oil. Naturally vegan.

pomegranate_fattoush.key_ingredients: Romaine, tomatoes, cucumbers, toasted pita, sumac, pomegranate molasses, olive oil
pomegranate_fattoush.rationale: 100% plant-based salad with olive oil dressing. Naturally vegan.

za\u2019atar_manakish.key_ingredients: Flatbread dough (flour, yeast, water, olive oil), dried thyme, sesame, sumac, olive oil
za\u2019atar_manakish.rationale: Authentic za'atar flatbread uses only olive oil and herbs; no dairy or eggs.

spinach_fatayer.key_ingredients: Dough (flour, water, olive oil), spinach, onions, sumac, lemon juice, pine nuts
spinach_fatayer.rationale: Traditional Middle Eastern spinach pies contain no dairy or egg wash.

tamees_bread.key_ingredients: Flour, water, yeast, salt, vegetable oil (tandoor-baked)
tamees_bread.rationale: Plain Saudi Tamees is simple leavened wheat bread. 100% vegan.

okra_tagine.key_ingredients: Baby okra pods, tomato sauce, garlic, coriander, olive oil
okra_tagine.rationale: Bamya bil-Zayt (oil-based okra stew without meat) is 100% plant-based.

spinach_stew.key_ingredients: Spinach, chickpeas, garlic, cilantro, onions, olive oil

sesame_brittle.key_ingredients: Toasted sesame seeds, sugar syrup, glucose, lemon juice, rose water
sesame_brittle.rationale: Traditional Simsimiya uses caramelized sugar syrup (no dairy, no honey).

onion_soup.key_ingredients: Onions, olive oil, vegetable broth, flour, cumin
onion_soup.rationale: Plant-based Arabic Shorbat Basal without cream/butter.

rice_pudding.key_ingredients: Short-grain rice, whole cow's milk, sugar, cream (ashta)
rice_pudding.rationale: Liquid base is whole dairy milk.

saffron_cake.key_ingredients: Flour, eggs, whole milk, condensed milk, evaporated milk, saffron cream
saffron_cake.rationale: High content of eggs, condensed milk, and dairy cream.

tamriya.key_ingredients: Dates, toasted flour, clarified butter (samneh / ghee), cardamom
tamriya.rationale: Authentic Saudi Tamriya is pan-roasted in dairy samneh/ghee.

pistachio_tamriya.rationale: Contains dairy butter/samneh in the date paste.

pistachio_sweet.key_ingredients: Semolina, sweet cheese, ashta (clotted dairy cream), clarified butter (samneh)
pistachio_sweet.rationale: Contains clotted dairy cream and ghee.

shawarma.key_ingredients: Spiced chicken/lamb/beef slices, garlic paste, pita

mixed_grill.key_ingredients: Assorted grilled meats (lamb kebab, tawook, chops)
